div.font:
Both resamples share a kernel: out = (1-mu) in[k] + mu in[k+1].
Range
: the source grid is uniform in j, so k and mu are closed form -- no search.
Azimuth
: the source (tan_s) is non-uniform, so k comes from a monotone merge scan.
